purpose: Test whether a small task-specific relationship hint can retain useful cross-file navigation while avoiding the broad map's repeated context cost. This is a benchmark-only experiment.
candidate: One highest-scoring local import relationship, with at most one additional high-scoring independent file; abstain if no sufficiently relevant relationship exists.
interpretation: Passing a one-run live comparison is only a feasibility signal; paired confirmation is required before a release claim. Failed offline gate means zero new model runs.
